Registry updated. Summary:

## GSM8K Full Eval Results (N=1319) — Standard GRPO 20%

| Seed | Accuracy | n_correct / n_total |
|------|----------|---------------------|
| 42 | 59.44% | 784 / 1319 |
| 123 | **59.89%** | 790 / 1319 |
| 456 | **60.20%** | 794 / 1319 |
| **3-seed mean** | **59.84%** | — |

N=200 quick eval 的高分 (seed456: 66.5%, seed123: 64.0%) 确认是小样本噪声，full eval 收敛到 ~60% 附近，三个 seed 标准差极小 (~0.3pp)。
